name: Wild West Bonanza

features.name: Assured-trigger buy
features.description: The bonus buy ensures a 4+ scatter trigger on the next spin.

review:
Wild West Bonanza takes the Bonanza formula to the frontier, with cowboy boots, hats and pistols, gunshots and galloping horses in the sound design. It uses refilling reels and pays anywhere on screen.

A multiplier symbol appears during free spins and takes a random value from 2x to 100x. Chance x2 makes it easier to land four or more scatters, while the bonus buy ensures that the next spin triggers free spins with at least four scatters. BGaming rates it high volatility, quotes a 15,000x maximum, and lists a 96% RTP. Free spins arrive around once every 395 spins on average. If you like western themes, this is the Bonanza variant to try.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 395 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
